purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt (Yakujo/prescription) printing subsystem - medication list print component HC30
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It handles printing of medication/prescription list details (Yakujo Ichiran Insatsu - HC30). It reads master data for medications, hospital information, and staff, then formats and outputs print data for a prescription/medication summary report.

notable_features: 13 CALL statements to ORCA subprograms (e.g. ORCSMKPASS)
LINKAGE SECTION with SPA-AREA and ORCHC30AREA (subprogram interface)
Japanese text in comments (Shift-JIS/EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
OCCURS clauses for multi-entry medication tables
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Fixed-format source with detailed revision history in comments
verdict.notes: File contains Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, decoded here as latin-1 causing mojibake in comments. This is clearly part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 86353 bytes total. The program is a subprogram (called with USING SPA-AREA ORCHC30AREA) for printing medication/prescription lists.
